name: latch
description: Chrome extension that lets browser AIs sign in, create accounts, pass 2FA and reset passwords without seeing your credentials. Includes an optional MCP server for terminal AIs.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:extension && node test/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/page.mjs test/domains.mjs test/auth-result.mjs test/guard.mjs test/frames.mjs test/private-focus.mjs test/cgi-account.mjs test/popup.mjs test/mail.mjs test/totp.mjs
scripts.test:extension: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/bar.mjs && node test/bridge.mjs && node test/loading.mjs
